lyrics: I love you mo rokuni iwanai
Dameda ne dame yo damena no yo
Dore dake tsuyoi o sake demo
Honma ni rokuna otoko ya nai
Dameda ne dame yo damena no yo
Dore dake tsuyoi o sake demo
Honma ni rokuna otoko ya nai
Na n'na no yo kono namida bakamitai

translations.english: It's foolish, so childish
Chasing dreams and getting hurt
Despite being so bad at lying
You showed me a smile that wasn't a smile

translations.romaji: I love you mo rokuni iwanai
translations.english: You couldn't even say "I love you" properly
You were truly clumsy with your words
And yet, and yet, why
Were you able to say goodbye?

translations.romaji: Dameda ne dame yo damena no yo
translations.english: It's no good, it's no good, it's just no good
I love you, I love you too much

translations.romaji: Dore dake tsuyoi o sake demo
translations.english: No matter how strong the liquor is
These undistorted memories are foolish
It's foolish, truly foolish
I did nothing but believe in you
Pretending to be a strong woman
Basking in the evening breeze of sadness
Three years have passed since I became alone
Even the townscape has changed
And yet, and yet, why
Only these lingering attachments are left behind

translations.romaji: Honma ni rokuna otoko ya nai
translations.english: You really aren't any good as a man
I'll take off our matching rings
Serves you right, it's a relief
It's foolish to keep waiting forever
